title: AI Recruiting Agent in Slack: GoGloby Reduced Scheduling by 75%

compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an AI software builder and standalone SaaS provider, an offer that conflicts with its staffing and recruiting positioning. Its product metrics and client testimonials are also unsupported by the company sources, so decide whether to remove or substantially revise the case study before keeping it live.
